import numpy as np, json, pandas as pd
mb={int(k):v for k,v in json.load(open("map_bov_to_human.json")).items()}
mh2r={int(k):v for k,v in json.load(open("human_to_ortholog_maps.json"))["A3GALT2_RAT"].items()}
def parse(fn, chain=None):
    at={}
    for L in open(fn):
        if L.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
        if L.startswith("ATOM"):
            if chain and L[21]!=chain: continue
            if L[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
            at.setdefault(int(L[22:26]),{"resn":L[17:20].strip(),"atoms":{}})["atoms"][L[12:16].strip()]=\
                np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
    return at
X=parse("xtal_1O7Q.pdb",chain="A"); H=parse("AF_human_A3GALT2.pdb"); R=parse("AF_rat_A3GALT2.pdb")
MN=None; UDP=[]
for L in open("xtal_1O7Q.pdb"):
    if L.startswith("HETATM"):
        rn,ch,ri=L[17:20].strip(),L[21],int(L[22:26])
        xyz=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
        if (rn,ch,ri)==("MN","A",1371): MN=xyz
        if (rn,ch,ri)==("UDP","A",1374): UDP.append((L[12:16].strip(),xyz))
print("catalytic-site ligands: MN A/1371, UDP A/1374 with",len(UDP),"atoms; Mn-UDP min dist",
      round(min(np.linalg.norm(u[1]-MN) for u in UDP),2),"A")
udp_pts=[u[1] for u in UDP]
beta_phos=[u[1] for u in UDP if u[0] in ("PB","O1B","O2B","O3B")]

def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc,Qc=P-P.mean(0),Q-Q.mean(0); V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc)
    Rt=V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt
    return Rt,P.mean(0),Q.mean(0)
def superpose(mov,ref,pairs):
    Pm=[];Pr=[]
    for a,b in pairs:
        if a in mov and b in ref and "CA" in mov[a]["atoms"] and "CA" in ref[b]["atoms"]:
            Pm.append(mov[a]["atoms"]["CA"]); Pr.append(ref[b]["atoms"]["CA"])
    Pm,Pr=np.array(Pm),np.array(Pr); Rt,cm,cr=kabsch(Pm,Pr)
    fit=lambda v:(v-cm)@Rt+cr
    return fit, float(np.sqrt(((fit(Pm)-Pr)**2).sum(1).mean())), len(Pm)
pairs_h=[(mb[b],b) for b in sorted(mb) if mb[b] and b in X and b>=82]
pairs_r=[(mh2r[mb[b]],b) for b in sorted(mb) if mb[b] and mh2r.get(mb[b]) and b in X and b>=82]
fitH,rmsH,nH=superpose(H,X,pairs_h); fitR,rmsR,nR=superpose(R,X,pairs_r)
print(f"human AF onto 1O7Q: {nH} CA pairs, RMSD {rmsH:.2f} A | rat AF onto 1O7Q: {nR} pairs, RMSD {rmsR:.2f} A")

spec=[("DVD Asp1 (Mn ligand)",225,199,198,["OD1","OD2"]),("DVD Asp2 (Mn ligand)",227,201,200,["OD1","OD2"]),
      ("catalytic Glu",317,291,290,["OE1","OE2"]),("donor-specificity His",280,254,253,["NE2","ND1"]),
      ("Asp316 equiv",316,290,289,["OD1","OD2"]),("Arg202 equiv",202,176,175,["NH1","NH2","NE"]),
      ("Lys359 equiv",359,333,332,["NZ"]),("Arg365 equiv",365,339,338,["NH1","NH2","NE"]),
      ("Trp314 equiv",314,288,287,["NE1"]),("His315 equiv",315,289,288,["NE2","ND1"])]
def mind(res,names,targets,fit):
    pts=[res["atoms"][n] for n in names if n in res["atoms"]]
    return round(float(min(np.linalg.norm(fit(p)-t) for p in pts for t in targets)),2)
ident=lambda v:v
rows=[]
for lab,bp,hp,rp,names in spec:
    rows.append((lab,f"{X[bp]['resn']}{bp}",f"{H[hp]['resn']}{hp}",
        mind(X[bp],names,[MN],ident), mind(H[hp],names,[MN],fitH), mind(R[rp],names,[MN],fitR),
        mind(X[bp],names,udp_pts,ident), mind(H[hp],names,udp_pts,fitH), mind(R[rp],names,udp_pts,fitR)))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["role","bovine","human","Mn:bov","Mn:human","Mn:rat","UDP:bov","UDP:human","UDP:rat"])
print(); print(T.to_string(index=False))
T.to_csv("superposed_ligand_distances.csv",index=False)

# visualise
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
x=np.arange(len(T)); w=0.26
for k,(c,lab) in enumerate(zip(["#1a7f5a","#2d6cdf","#d1495b"],["bovine 1O7Q crystal","human AlphaFold","rat AlphaFold"])):
    ax[0].bar(x+(k-1)*w,T.iloc[:,3+k],w,color=c,label=lab)
    ax[1].bar(x+(k-1)*w,T.iloc[:,6+k],w,color=c,label=lab)
for a,t,yl in [(ax[0],"Distance to catalytic Mn(2+) of 1O7Q","distance to Mn (A)"),
               (ax[1],"Distance to bound UDP of 1O7Q","distance to UDP (A)")]:
    a.set_xticks(x); a.set_xticklabels(T.role,rotation=40,ha="right",fontsize=8)
    a.set_title(t,fontsize=11,loc="left"); a.set_ylabel(yl); a.legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].axhline(2.5,ls="--",c="k",lw=.9); ax[0].text(0.1,2.65,"metal coordination range",fontsize=8)
plt.suptitle("Human A3GALT2 catalytic residues occupy the donor and metal site after superposition onto bovine alpha3GT",
             fontsize=12,y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
